## Automation surface (§20.E)
- No new script, job, workflow or supervisor. The change extends five existing helpers (the head-gate helper, the gate and diff-context step bodies, the security pass and the PR-checks library).
- Trigger: the existing `review_autofix.yml` `codex-agent` job (pull_request / dispatch). The marker is posted from the `Push all pending commits` step. The gate output comes from `Evaluate review gate`. The diff and the security pass use the `Generate diff context` and `Single-issue security pass` steps. The final-CI decision runs in `Enable auto-merge on PR`, through `review_enable_auto_merge.sh` and `_pr_wait_for_required_checks`.
- No DB work and no registry entry in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`, because no new script is added.

## Functions or modules to implement

The model to copy throughout is the final-CI repair delta review: `review_head_gate_final_ci_repair` (`scripts/review_head_gate.sh:330-403`), the gate block at `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1978-2015`, and the delta branch at `scripts/review_autofix_step_generate_diff_context.sh:146-183`.

1. **`_pr_merge_resolve_marker_post <pr> <pre-resolution head>`** (new; `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`, placed after `_pr_base_sync_marker_post`; the name is checked unused, `grep` finds 0 hits).
   - It returns 0 silently unless `CONFLICT_RESOLVED=true` and `MERGE_RESOLVE_DELTA_REVIEW_ENABLED` is on. The switch reads true when empty or `true` (any case); `false` turns it off; any other value warns and counts as off.
   - Local checks on the pushed `HEAD`, with no API read:
     - exactly two parents (`HEAD^2` exists, `HEAD^3` does not);
     - `HEAD^1` equals the pre-resolution head (40-hex `LOCAL_HEAD_SHA`, which is `INITIAL_HEAD_SHA`);
     - the subject starts with `[ai-merge-resolve]`;
     - base tip = `HEAD^2`.
   - These checks fail when autofix commits sit before or after the resolution, or when the push loop's retry merge (`git merge --no-ff origin/<branch>`) produced HEAD. In those cases no marker is posted.
   - Reads, only after the local checks pass: one `gh api user` for the GH_PAT login, then one `commits/<from>/statuses?per_page=100`. The newest `ai-review/head-gate` status must be `success` and its creator must equal that login (case-insensitive).
   - It posts a short prose line plus the final line `<!-- ai:merge-resolve from=<from> resolve=<HEAD> base=<HEAD^2> -->`. It uses the same single-attempt `_safe_gh_jq -X POST repos/<repo>/issues/<pr>/comments` as `_pr_base_sync_marker_post`, followed by `gh_pr_cache_evict ... issue_comments`.
   - Every outcome logs `MERGE_RESOLVE_MARKER pr= head= outcome=posted|skipped|failed reason=<token>`. Tokens: `disabled`, `not_resolution`, `parent_mismatch`, `from_not_approved`, `read_failed`, `post_failed`.
2. **`_pr_merge_resolve_final_ci_quick <repo> <pr> <head sha>`** (new; `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`). It prints `true` or `false`, and does nothing and prints `false` when `REVIEW_REMERGE_HEAD` is empty, which is true for every other caller.
   - All of these must hold for `true`:
     - `REVIEW_REMERGE_HEAD` equals `<head sha>` exactly;
     - `from` = local `git rev-parse --verify -q <head>^1` resolves, `^2` exists and `^3` does not;
     - the `ci_sync_quick.sh delta-supported` probe prints `delta_supported`;
     - `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` is in `true/1/yes/on`, the same parse as `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci`, line 2384;
     - `ci_sync_quick.sh full-ci-green <repo> <pr> <from> ${REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW}` passes.
   - It logs `MERGE_RESOLVE_FINAL_CI pr= head= outcome=quick|full reason=<token>`.
   - Call site: the `_pr_ensure_final_ci` call inside `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (currently line 1574). Prefix that call with `PR_FINAL_CI_SYNC_QUICK="$(_pr_merge_resolve_final_ci_quick ...)"`, guarded by `type ... >/dev/null` so an older library keeps today's call.
   - `ci_sync_quick.sh verify` already accepts any `[approved head, base tip]` two-parent merge with a full-green approved head (lines 165-205, 304-357), so `scripts/ci_sync_quick.sh` needs no change. Its existing `sync_quick_failed` path in `_pr_ensure_final_ci` (line 1395) gives the full run after a failed quick run.
3. **`review_head_gate_merge_resolve`** (new; `scripts/review_head_gate.sh`). It adds the dispatcher case `merge-resolve) shift; review_head_gate_merge_resolve "$@" ;;` and extends the usage text.
   - Arguments: `<repo> <pr> <head> <base ref> <login> <comments file>`. Inputs are validated the same way as `freshness_sync` (lines 262-267).
   - The marker is parsed with jq: author equal to login (case-insensitive), body ending in `<!-- ai:merge-resolve from=([0-9a-f]{40}) resolve=([0-9a-f]{40}) base=([0-9a-f]{40}) -->\s*$`, `resolve == head`, and the last one wins.
   - Read 1: `commits/<head>` with jq `{parents, committer name/email, author name/email}`.
     - Parents must equal `from,base` exactly (`head_is_not_the_resolution`).
     - The committer, or the author, must have name `codex-bot` or `claude-bot` and email `<name>@users.noreply.invalid`. This is the `final-ci-repair` identity guard (`identity_not_pipeline`).
   - Read 2: `commits/<from>/statuses`. The newest `ai-review/head-gate` status must be `success`, created by the login (`from_not_approved`).
   - Read 3: `compare/<base>...<base ref>` must report `ahead` or `identical` (`base_parent_not_on_base`), as `freshness_sync` checks at lines 309-324.
   - A failed read logs `*_read_failed`.
   - Logs: `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE mode=merge_resolve pr= head= outcome=delta|review reason=<token>`. On success it prints `merge_resolve_from=<from>`, returns 0, and sets `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_MERGE_RESOLVE_FROM` for sourcing callers. Anything else returns 1.
4. **Gate block** (`scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh`, appended after the final-CI delta block, before the outputs).
   - Normalise the switch the same way as `final_ci_delta_switch`.
   - It runs only when all hold: `SHOULD_RUN=true`, `FINAL_CI_REPAIR!=true`, `REVIEW_DIFF_BASE_SHA` is empty, `HEAD_GATE_HELPER_VERIFIED=true`, the switch is on, `gate_fetch_marker_comments` is `ok`, and `grep -Fq "resolve=${pr_head_sha_gate} "`.
   - It then calls `.codex-head-gate-src/scripts/review_head_gate.sh merge-resolve ... "${pr_base_ref_gate:-${pr_base_ref:-}}" ...` and echoes the `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE` line.
   - It sets `REVIEW_REMERGE_HEAD=<head>` only when `merge_resolve_from` is 40-hex. It writes `review_remerge_head=<head>` to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` **only when non-empty**, so that with the switch off the outputs are byte-identical to today's.
   - Also append `or ($b | contains("<!-- ai:merge-resolve "))` to the body filter in `gate_fetch_marker_comments` (line 366). Without it, the GH_PAT (User) marker body is reduced to an empty activity record. Update the comment block at lines 325-343 to match.
5. **Diff context** (`scripts/review_autofix_step_generate_diff_context.sh`): a new block placed before the existing `review_diff_context_range` block. When `REVIEW_REMERGE_HEAD` is set, it runs and the existing block runs only in its `else`. It falls back with `remerge_failed` in any of these cases:
   - `REVIEW_REMERGE_HEAD` is not 40-hex or not equal to `git rev-parse HEAD`;
   - git is older than 2.36 (parsed from `git version`);
   - the parents are not exactly two;
   - `git fetch --no-tags origin <from> <base>` fails;
   - the merge base is still missing after up to 4 rounds of `git fetch --no-tags --deepen=200 origin <from> <base>`, with `--unshallow` last, mirroring `_ensure_merge_base_reachable`;
   - `git show --remerge-diff --format= <head>` fails or produces an empty file.

   On fallback, `LAST_RUN_*` stays untouched and the step logs `REVIEW_DIFF_CONTEXT range=merge_base reason=remerge_failed`. On success it moves the diff into `LAST_RUN_DIFF_FILE` and writes `LAST_RUN_CHANGED_FILES_FILE` with `--name-only` and `LAST_RUN_DIFF_STAT_FILE` with `--stat`, using the same `--remerge-diff --format=` options. If either of those fails, the step also falls back. Success logs `REVIEW_DIFF_CONTEXT range=remerge base=<from>`. `PR_DIFF_FILE` and `PR_CHANGED_FILES_FILE` are never touched (D4).
6. **Security pass** (`scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh`, `single_pass_base_sync_carry`):
   - Inside the existing subshell, after `review_head_gate_freshness_sync` returns non-zero, call `review_head_gate_merge_resolve`. This happens only when `MERGE_RESOLVE_DELTA_REVIEW_ENABLED` is not `false` and the comments file contains `resolve=<head>`. Print its rc and `REVIEW_HEAD_GATE_MERGE_RESOLVE_FROM` as extra fields.
   - On a verified head whose `from` has a newest `clean` marker, set a new variable (suggested name `single_pass_remerge_since`; check it is unused), log `mode=gate pr= head= outcome=merge_resolve_carry from=<from>`, and return through `single_pass_carry_skip <head> merge_resolve_audit`.
